name: arno-financeiro
description: Sistema de controle financeiro do Grupo Escoteiro Arno Friedrich

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:int && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w frontend && npm run test:unit -w backend
